data.narrative:
Terranova is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $7M to date. The valuation landscape for this sector comprises nine private peers and one public comparable (277810.KQ), including established names like Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, and Locus Robotics.

Given data constraints, only the stage-progression method is applicable here. This approach uses the $7M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression in venture capital, yielding an implied valuation of $18M. A peer-median approach could not be reliably executed due to insufficient datapoints meeting narrow filters—only one same-stage comparable exists in the robotics sector, falling short of the three-company minimum threshold needed for statistical validity.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $15M to $20M, with a midpoint of $18M. This range reflects a 15% downside case and upside case around the stage-progression result. The primary uncertainty is the absence of tightly comparable seed-stage precedents in robotics and manufacturing, which limits confidence in the step-up multiplier's applicability to Terranova's specific profile. Any refinement of this range would require either additional seed-stage robotics comps or forward-looking revenue/capability data not present in this dataset.
